messages:
Maria Gomez: Quick sync — need a plan for weekend paid push for the webinar signups. main asks: tighten retargeting window, creative refresh, and short-term pacing adjustments.
Aj Patel: timeline? we have the new hero creative ready, can swap tonight.
Maria Gomez: ideal swap by 10pm PST so it runs Sat-Sun. keep both old+new for 50/50 for 12h then shift.
Samir Rana: for search, recommend +8% bid multiplier on branded terms and pause low-converting longtails. past 7 days conv rate shows big skew to branded.
Leah Chen: for retargeting, shorten to 7-day window and increase frequency cap to 5/day for top-funnel viewers? worried about ad fatigue.
Zack O'Neill: let's do 7-day for engaged users only (visited pricing or demo). avoid showing to converters.
Maria Gomez: agreed. Leah, can you update audience filters to exclude conversions and include pricing/demo 7-day?
Leah Chen: will do. routing question — webinar signups should go straight to SDR queue with high-intent tag. Config in the webhook?
Aj Patel: yes, add utm_campaign=webinar_apr, utm_content=creativeA/B, and lead_source=paid. webhook sends to /integrations/sdr-leads.
Maria Gomez: paste for the ad copy + UTM so ops can implement:
```
utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=webinar_apr&utm_content={creative_variant}&lead_source=paid
```
Aj Patel: creative notes — variant A focuses product value (30s), variant B is persona-led (testimonial clip). keep same CTA.
Samir Rana: pacing suggestion: cap daily spend at 1.2x baseline for Sat and Sun, but throttle by CPA threshold of $85. if CPA > $85 for 3 hours, scale back to baseline.
AdOpsBot: Deploy plan queued: creative swap (1849 -> 1850), audience change (retarget_7d_exclude_conv), bid mods (+8% branded), spend cap rules. ETA tonight 22:00 PST.
Zack O'Neill: can we add a quick PV metric to the dashboard for landing page load time? landing perf spike last week hurt conversions.
Leah Chen: added PV and ttfb to the dashboard, will alert if >2s during campaign.
Maria Gomez: perfect. Samir, can you monitor early CPA and ping if we hit thresholds?
Samir Rana: on it. I'll post an update thread if we breach. :thumbsup:
Maria Gomez: thanks team — aim to retest creative learnings Mon morning and decide whether to scale.
Aj Patel: logging the rollout notes in Asana and tagging the campaign task. link: https://app.asana.com/0/123456789/987654321
Zack O'Neill: heads-up for SDRs — routing test for first 50 leads to SDR-team-alpha, then full queue. Leah, can you set routing?
Leah Chen: set it up, first 50 -> SDR-alpha, remaining -> SDR-main. will include high-intent flag.
Maria Gomez: great. closing thread — will follow up Sun night with learnings. :rocket:
